coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The state Revenue BhuNaksha viewer provides cadastral map access, and the Rajnandgaon district administration publishes revenue-service links. The selector resolves the city-named village within the Rajnandgaon tehsil/RI hierarchy.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous public selector and village extent are verified; safe source-native parcel polygons with stable IDs are not verified.

technicalBlocker: Current public viewer routes returned selector metadata, map extent, WMS/raster layer configuration, and layer metadata, but no bounded safe parcel ID+full geometry response. The WMS GetCapabilities request returned HTTP 500 with an empty body.
remainingUncertainty: The valid village extent covers the official Rajnandgaon village selector, but its relation to the unchanged WUP point and the availability/semantics of parcel-native vector geometry were not established. A zero or unavailable exact-point query would not establish citywide absence.
nextStep: A serial reviewer should qualify whether the current viewer has an anonymous vector/identify route and native parcel identity, using the unchanged WUP point only as a bounded check and without submitting unsafe fields.
pointBasis: Exact unchanged WUP 2025 settlement point (latitude, longitude); not shifted to force a parcel hit.
registryBasis: Rajnandgaon district administration publishes revenue services, and the state Revenue BhuNaksha viewer resolves the city-named cadastral village under district 42 / tehsil 05 / RI 15.
